channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Source: Utah Jazz star Lauri Markkanen injured in practice, to get MRI
item.description: Utah Jazz star Lauri Markkanen suffered an injury in practice on Wednesday, according to a source.

item.title: Son of ‘Real Housewives of Salt Lake City’ star Mary Cosby dies at 23
item.description: Robert Cosby Jr., the son of "Real Housewives of Salt Lake City" star Mary Cosby, has died at 23. His candid struggles with substance misuse were highlighted on the Utah reality show.

item.title: Utah Gov. Spencer Cox says sports betting on Kalshi is ‘destroying lives.’ The data is on his side.
item.description: Prediction markets have created a loophole that has effectively legalized gambling in Utah. There’s plenty of research to show the downsides.

item.title: Prop 4 repeal has essentially hit statewide signature goal — but fate is still uncertain
item.description: The GOP-backed effort to restore the Utah lawmakers' ability to gerrymander political districts is on track to meet its statewide signature goal — but its fate isn't certain.

item.title: Iconic 1960s-era starburst sign in SLC gets an upgrade
item.description: One of the best-known vintage signs in Salt Lake City's Sugar House neighborhood is getting an upgrade this week.

item.title: Security heightened at Utah mosques after shooting. Imam says ‘God is the ultimate protector.’
item.description: After a gunman fired shots at Imam Shuaib Din, he had to reassure them in his Ramadan sermon amid increased security at the Utah Islamic Center, the state's largest mosque.

item.title: LDS Church cleared to drill 20 wells for controversial Heber Valley Temple
item.description: Wells for the Heber temple should have a small impact on the local water supply, but scientists say Utah’s overall groundwater health requires a more holistic look.

item.title: Watch: Salt Lake Tribune journalists answer your questions about Utah GOP’s effort to repeal Proposition 4
item.description: Join a YouTube livestream conversation with Salt Lake Tribune journalists on Tuesday afternoon to ask your questions about the effort to repeal Proposition 4.

item.title: Gov. Cox took aim at sports betting apps. Kalshi is fighting back — in court.
item.description: Utah’s attorney general says “you can bet” he’s going to “do something” about prediction apps. Kalshi wants to stop him from trying to rein in the company in the state.

item.title: ‘Mormon Land’ tribute: Historian Ardis Parshall talks about pioneer adventures and misadventures
item.description: In a tribute to Salt Lake Tribune guest columnist Ardis Parshall, who died earlier this week, we are replaying this “Mormon Land” episode from last July in which the noted research historian discussed one of her favorite topics: Latter-day Saint pioneers.
